d: After leaving her big city life behind, wedding photographer Jessie Brookes is happier than ever. When famous actor Nate Brown shows up on her parent's vineyard for his sister's wedding, she quickly realizes that there is more to him than meets the eye.
Jessica Tucker, a widow and successful doctor, is trying to juggle work and family when she learns she's up for the top job at the hospital.

Max and Page are a mother and daughter con team with a devious routine. Max targets wealthy men, lures them into marriage and then Page seduces them, leaving Max to discover their infidelity and reap the huge divorce settlements which tide them over until they target their next victim.
A womanizing Viagra salesman with no sense of direction or responsibility falls in love with a free-spirited woman.
